The Mimic's Hand

Choose up to five cards from an eight-card hand. A pair, two pair, three-of-a-kind, straight, flush, full house, four-of-a-kind, or straight flush produces increasingly powerful damage. Click selected cards again to remove them.

Play a hand to attack. The enemy's countdown decreases; when it reaches zero, the enemy retaliates. Your played cards are replenished. You may discard selected cards to redraw, up to three times per encounter. Defeat enemies to purchase sigils and progress deeper through the forest.

Keys: 1–9 select cards · Enter play · R redraw
